content: Screw all the M3x12 in place first, leave it for ten minutes to cool down and then slowly remove the screws.

replies.content: +1 this method.  Get a bit / electric drill to make your day go better.

content: I used a drill with a T10 bit. Go slow and switch out the screws for every tap, they get really hot
Wish I had a tap set for this..
this repetative work needs an electric screwdriver....
Pre-thread the holes with an M3 tap. Also recommend using M3x12 hex screws instead. You get a better grip and less likely to strip the head.
careful not to burn your fingers (screw gets really hot) when using the same screw for all the tool holders
Be careful not to strip the threads. These will be fastened to the front plate and then adjusted after toolhead calibration.
